reason: Wanting text smaller means the text is too big, which text_too_small excludes.
Small print on a medicine bottle is not a phone problem.
Turning the internet off is the opposite of a no_internet fix.
A dim bike headlight is not a phone screen problem.
A screen that is too bright is excluded because the fix only brightens.
The phone's text is too small to read.
Wi-Fi is connected with full bars yet the website does not load.
Shoes being too small is not a phone problem.
Asking how to switch on the net is a command for a no_internet fix (mobile data on).
A dark room with a dead bulb is not a phone problem.
Lowering brightness is the opposite of the brightness_up fix.
The camera is black in every app including the camera app, so it is a broken camera, not a permission.
The camera is black in the regular camera app too, so it is broken in every app.
Their writing is tiny and they want it bigger like their mum's.
A how-to question for brightening the screen belongs to screen_too_dim.
Turning off do not disturb is a command owned by phone_not_ringing.
Text that is too big is excluded from text_too_small.
The phone makes no sound for incoming calls.
Read as a command, switching mobile data off is the opposite of the mobile_data_on fix.
The camera itself won't take photos with no other app named, which points to a camera fault rather than an app permission.
The camera fails in the video call and in the camera app itself, so it is broken in every app.
Every app says offline, which is no internet with no mention of connected Wi-Fi.
Small font in a textbook is not about the phone's text.
The screen dims toward timeout while reading and needs tapping to stay on, which is the screen timeout problem.
The data pack has run out, which is a recharge matter, not a setting Unstuk can fix.
The daily data quota is used up, which is a recharge matter.
A Bluetooth speaker that won't charge is a battery problem, not a connection one.
A used-up data allowance is a recharge matter.
A question about the sky is not a phone problem.
Turning Bluetooth off is the opposite of the bluetooth_on fix.
The request is to turn Bluetooth off, the opposite of the bluetooth_on fix.
Turning off private DNS is a command owned by wifi_no_load.
A ringtone that is too loud is excluded from phone_not_ringing.
The camera shows black in every app including the normal camera, so it is a broken camera.
A purple tint with normal brightness is a strange tint, which §5 assigns to colours_wrong rather than overall darkness, and it is not the warm yellow Night Light case.
§4 lists Private DNS questions under wifi_no_load, and websites failing on Wi-Fi after a Private DNS change matches it.
An inverted screen with light and dark switched is listed as colours_wrong in §4.
